selection_policy: Fixed locations and views chosen before inspecting raster elevations or occlusion results. Do not raise terrain or search for a visually impressive shadow.
surface_type: DSM including vegetation/buildings; not bare-earth DTM
reference: Independent raster-height segment traversal using the same triangulated piecewise-linear surface; add sampling/geometry-resolution checks separately.
limits: DEM geometry and LOS cross-check, not co-located measured radar validation
All-visible results are retained, not treated as failed selection
